method: Lightweight actual public Greenhouse board discovery identified official legacy listing URLs. Existing ATS identity matcher verified board/posting identity of current approved-host URL before actual guarded page fetch. No legacy/custom host fetched. Original source title/metadata/header/description excerpted, forms/scripts/buttons/inputs/SVG removed; raw hashes/capture times preserved. Labels frozen before prediction. No model/Google/owner data/forms/network changes.
limits: Two targeted Figma internships, same ATS; not representative or multi-ATS validation.
Both have four numeric month/day start options without explicit years in that sentence; Summer2027 title does not establish a unique exact start date.
Application5-per30days and90day reapplication limits are not a calendar application deadline.
No exact-date positive or role-specific sponsorship policy. Internship labels stay Unverified, not personal eligibility.
Separate two-case negative-control set, not padded into a fresh acceptance-sized benchmark.
